fact: In the combination group, BMD was unchanged compared with the placebo group at the hip (mean change, −0.006 g/cm²; 95% CI, −0.017 to 0.004 g/cm²; P = .24) and lumbar spine (mean change, −0.010 g/cm²; 95% CI, −0.025 to 0.005 g/cm²; P = .20).
fact_zh: 在联合治疗组中，与安慰剂组相比，髋部（平均变化，−0.006 g/cm²；95% CI，−0.017 到 0.004 g/cm²；P = .24）和腰椎（平均变化，−0.010 g/cm²；95% CI，−0.025 到 0.005 g/cm²；P = .20）的骨密度没有变化。
quote: In the combination group, BMD was unchanged compared with the placebo group at the hip (mean change, −0.006 g/cm 2 ; 95% CI, −0.017 to 0.004 g/cm 2 ; P = .24) and lumbar spine (mean change, −0.010 g/cm 2 ; 95% CI, −0.025 to 0.005 g/cm 2 ; P = .20) (Figure 2 A and B).

fact: In the liraglutide group, hip BMD decreased compared with the exercise group (mean change, −0.013 g/cm²; 95% CI, −0.024 to −0.001 g/cm²; P = .03) and placebo group (mean change, −0.013 g/cm²; 95% CI, −0.024 to −0.002 g/cm²; P = .02).
fact_zh: 在利拉鲁肽组中，与运动组（平均变化，−0.013 g/cm²；95% CI，−0.024 到 −0.001 g/cm²；P = .03）和安慰剂组（平均变化，−0.013 g/cm²；95% CI，−0.024 到 −0.002 g/cm²；P = .02）相比，髋部骨密度下降。
quote: In the liraglutide group, hip BMD decreased compared with the exercise group (mean change, −0.013 g/cm 2 ; 95% CI, −0.024 to −0.001 g/cm 2 ; P = .03) and placebo group (mean change, −0.013 g/cm 2 ; 95% CI, −0.024 to −0.002 g/cm 2 ; P = .02).

fact: In the liraglutide group, lumbar spine BMD decreased compared with the exercise group (mean change, −0.016 g/cm²; 95% CI, −0.032 to −0.001 g/cm²; P = .04) and placebo group (mean change, −0.019 g/cm²; 95% CI, −0.034 to 0.002 g/cm²; P = .02).
fact_zh: 在利拉鲁肽组中，与运动组（平均变化，−0.016 g/cm²；95% CI，−0.032 到 −0.001 g/cm²；P = .04）和安慰剂组（平均变化，−0.019 g/cm²；95% CI，−0.034 到 0.002 g/cm²；P = .02）相比，腰椎骨密度下降。
quote: Likewise, in the liraglutide group, lumbar spine BMD decreased compared with the exercise group (mean change, −0.016 g/cm 2 ; 95% CI, −0.032 to −0.001g/cm 2 ; P = .04) and placebo group (mean change, −0.019 g/cm 2 ; 95% CI, −0.034 to 0.002 g/cm 2 ; P = .02).

fact: The combination treatment led to the largest weight and body fat reduction while preserving hip, spine, and forearm BMD levels compared with the placebo group.
fact_zh: 联合治疗导致最大的体重和体脂减少，同时与安慰剂组相比，保留了髋部、脊柱和前臂的骨密度水平。
quote: The combination treatment led to the largest weight and body fat reduction while preserving hip, spine, and forearm BMD levels compared with the placebo group.

fact: Liraglutide alone led to weight and fat loss compared with placebo; however, this was associated with decreased hip and spine BMD compared with placebo and exercise alone.
fact_zh: 单独使用利拉鲁肽与安慰剂相比，导致体重和脂肪减少；然而，这与安慰剂和单独运动相比，髋部和脊柱骨密度下降有关。
quote: Liraglutide alone led to weight and fat loss compared with placebo; however, this was associated with decreased hip and spine BMD compared with placebo and exercise alone.

fact: Exercise alone led to similar weight loss as liraglutide alone but with increased lean mass and preserved hip and spine BMD.
fact_zh: 单独运动导致与单独使用利拉鲁肽相似的体重减少，但增加了瘦体重并保留了髋部和脊柱的骨密度。
quote: Exercise alone led to similar weight loss as liraglutide alone but with increased lean mass and preserved hip and spine BMD.

fact: Despite a substantial weight loss of 16.9 kg for the combination group vs 7.0 kg for the placebo group, the combination treatment preserved site-specific BMD compared with placebo.
fact_zh: 尽管联合治疗组的体重减少达16.9公斤，而安慰剂组仅为7.0公斤，但联合治疗保留了与安慰剂组相比的特定部位骨密度。
quote: Despite a substantial weight loss of 16.9 kg for the combination group vs 7.0 kg for the placebo group, the combination treatment preserved site-specific BMD compared with placebo.

fact: Liraglutide without exercise was also effective by maintaining a 13.7 kg weight loss after 1 year, which was 6.4 kg more than the placebo group.
fact_zh: 没有运动的利拉鲁肽在一年内也有效，保持了13.7公斤的体重减少，比安慰剂组多6.4公斤。
quote: Liraglutide without exercise was also effective by maintaining a 13.7 kg weight loss after 1 year, which was 6.4 kg more than the placebo group.

fact: The liraglutide and combination treatments were associated with increased whole-body BMD.
fact_zh: 利拉鲁肽和联合治疗与全身骨密度增加有关。
quote: Compared with placebo, the liraglutide and combination treatments were associated with increased whole-body BMD (eFigure 2 in Supplement 2 ).

fact: The low-calorie diet increased P-CTX, the marker of bone resorption, by 27% and P-P1NP, the marker of bone formation, by 7%.
fact_zh: 低碳水化合物饮食使骨吸收标志物P-CTX增加了27%，骨形成标志物P-P1NP增加了7%。
quote: The low-calorie diet increased P-CTX, the marker of bone resorption, by 27% and P-P1NP, the marker of bone formation, by 7%.

fact: The mean (SD) exercise volume was 118 (74) minutes/week at a mean (SD) intensity of 78% (4%) of maximum heart rate in the exercise group and 111 (73) minutes/week at 79% (5%) of maximum heart rate in the combination group.
fact_zh: 运动组的平均（SD）运动量为每周118（74）分钟，平均（SD）强度为最大心率的78%（4%），联合组的平均（SD）运动量为每周111（73）分钟，平均强度为最大心率的79%（5%）。
quote: As previously reported, 19 the mean (SD) exercise volume was 118 (74) minutes/week at a mean (SD) intensity of 78% (4%) of maximum heart rate in the exercise group and 111 (73) minutes/week at 79% (5%) of maximum heart rate in the combination group.

fact: Total estimated mean change in weight loss during the study was 7.03 kg (95% CI, 4.25-9.80 kg) in the placebo group, 11.19 kg (95% CI, 8.40-13.99 kg) in the exercise group, 13.74 kg (95% CI, 11.04-16.44 kg) in the liraglutide group, and 16.88 kg (95% CI, 14.23-19.54 kg) in the combination group.
sec: Results / Body Weight and Body Composition
quote: Total estimated mean change in weight loss during the study was 7.03 kg (95% CI, 4.25-9.80 kg) in the placebo group, 11.19 kg (95% CI, 8.40-13.99 kg) in the exercise group, 13.74 kg (95% CI, 11.04-16.44 kg) in the liraglutide group, and 16.88 kg (95% CI, 14.23-19.54 kg) in the combination group.

fact: A total of 195 participants (mean [SD] age, 42.84 [11.87] years; 124 female [64%] and 71 male [36%]; mean [SD] BMI, 37.00 [2.92]) completed the low-calorie diet and were randomized to the exercise group (48 participants), liraglutide group (49 participants), combination group (49 participants), or placebo group (49 participants).
fact_zh: 共有195名参与者（平均[SD]年龄，42.84[11.87]岁；124名女性[64%]和71名男性[36%]；平均[SD]BMI，37.00[2.92]）完成了低碳水化合物饮食，并被随机分配到运动组（48名参与者）、利拉鲁肽组（49名参与者）、联合组（49名参与者）或安慰剂组（49名参与者）。
quote: A total of 195 participants (mean [SD] age, 42.84 [11.87] years; 124 female [64%] and 71 male [36%]; mean [SD] BMI, 37.00 [2.92]) completed the low-calorie diet and were randomized to the exercise group (48 participants), liraglutide group (49 participants), combination group (49 participants), or placebo group (49 participants).
